cells.gaps: No evidence row is held on local government revenue records. Only a state-level revenue system is named, the Anambra State IGR portal, under a 2024 law merging state and local government levies into one demand notice. Also held are federal and state land information programmes and a local addressing database fed by local government areas, classed as a survey. Whether any local government area keeps its own digital revenue record is not established.
cells.note: No row on the sub-indicator, so no rung can be set. An upper-tier system is noted, not assessed, and one state does not carry the country.
